node.description: Node identity — unique identifier and cryptographic private key

id.description: Unique 16-character hex ID of this node (e.g., 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8')

private_key.description: Base64-encoded Curve25519 private key (32 bytes, ed25519 compatible)

name.description: Mesh name — all nodes in the same VPN must share this name

subnet.description: IPv4 CIDR for the virtual LAN (must be non-RFC1918, non-overlapping)

ipv6_subnet.description: IPv6 CIDR for the virtual LAN (leave empty to disable IPv6)

discovery.description: How the node discovers other peers in the mesh

method.description: Discovery method: static (hard-coded peers), mdns (local multicast), or bootstrap (central server)

items.description: A known peer in static mode

peers.description: List of static peer entries (used only when method = 'static')

bootstrap_servers.description: List of bootstrap server URLs (used only when method = 'bootstrap')

mdns_service.description: mDNS service name suffix (used only when method = 'mdns')

listeners.description: Addresses and ports to bind to for incoming connections

ext_ip.description: Public IP to advertise (leave empty to auto-detect, e.g., via STUN)

stun_server.description: STUN server for NAT traversal (empty string to disable)

salt.description: 64-character hex salt used for key derivation (must be identical across all peers)

mtu_discovery.description: Enable Path MTU discovery (recommended for most deployments)

handshake_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a handshake (after which peer is dropped)

file.description: Path to write logs (e.g., '/var/log/opengnb/opengnb.log'); empty = log only to stderr

max_size_mb.description: Maximum size (MB) per log file before rotation (0 = no rotation)

max_files.description: Number of old log files to retain

experimental.description: Experimental features — enable only if you understand the implications

mesh_routing.description: Enable full-mesh shortest-path routing (Dijkstra); otherwise only direct peers are used

gossip_topology.description: Enable topology gossip; increases bandwidth but improves convergence
